INHERENT JURISDICTION

 CURATIVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.120 OF 2021

 REVIEW PETITION (CIVIL) NO.1857 OF 2020

 CIVIL APPEAL NO.2906 OF 2020

 PM COLD STORAGE PRIVATE LIMITED Petitioner

 VERSUS

 MONOTRONE LEASING PRIVATE LIMITED Respondent

 O R D E R
We have gone through the curative petition and the

 relevant documents.
In our opinion, no case is made out within the

 parameters indicated in the decision of this Court in

 Rupa Ashok Hurra vs. Ashok Hurra & Another, (2002) 4 SCC
388.
